name: Big watering can sample
description: Replicated extension sample (Replication.Extension): the game's Watering Can holds 2,000 charges; Kiln clients with this mod get the true water on Kiln's channel (bigcan:water@1) while a can holds more than 1,023 charges, which the game's own 16-bit number cannot show, and their HUD shows it. Players without the mod never get a frame.
